programme.title: The Highest Pass
programme.desc: Part heart-pounding adventure, part spiritual quest, THE HIGHEST PASS, a feature length documentary, premiered in Los Angeles to sold out audiences. The award-winning film shares the journey of seven seekers, including one who has never ridden a motorcycle, who follow a guru with a Vedic death prophecy on a moto journey up to the highest pass of the Indian Himalayas. Over 21 days and up to an elevation of 18,000 feet along a winding road, they never let low oxygen, altitude sickness, river-flooded roads, icy edges, snow and loaded trucks dampen their spirits or, ultimately, their deeper selves.

programme.desc: Phil Fogarty, owner of PSA Security, discusses his business struggles and funding needs with Joe Camberato, CEO of National Business Capital. Phil emphasizes his motivation to succeed for his family and seeks guidance on refining his pitch and understanding financial metrics.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.sub-title: Fund Tank - Kids of Valor Academy
programme.desc: Mona Jackson, owner of Kids of Valor Academy, seeks funding of $600,000 to support her childcare business, which currently operates four locations. Mona shares her inspiring journey, highlighting her commitment to providing affordable childcare in urban areas, driven by her own experiences as a teen mother. She plans to expand her academy to seven locations and aims to create a safe haven for women leaving domestic violence situations. Mona discusses her revenue, profitability, and organizational structure, emphasizing her all-female management team and the positive impact she aims to make in her community.
